chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from ʿAli ibn Riʾab, from Ziyad ibn Suqah, from Abi Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in one of you praying in a single garment while its buttons are undone. Indeed, the religion of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم is upright and inclining to truth.

key_terms.دِينُ مُحَمَّدٍ: the religion brought by Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray with the buttons of one's garment undone?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there is no problem in performing salat in a single garment even if its buttons are left undone. It conveys ease in ritual practice and describes the religion of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as upright and unburdensome.
